copy_9eb55df16044d538: A Singular Conviction: Freshness is Non-Negotiable
copy_b806ba8d26c55ae0: was founded with a straightforward belief: tea tastes extraordinary when it is consumed as close as possible to the mountain soil and garden furnace where it was fired. For generations, commodity trading created an elongated chain of auctions, warehouses, and brokers where tea leaves aged for months before packaging. We replaced that system with a direct garden-to-caddy model rooted right at the foot of the hills.
copy_31af9d7a2a2eabe7: Siliguri sits at the geographic confluence where the steep Himalayan ridges of Darjeeling slope downward to meet the tea plains of the Dooars, Terai, and Assam. Nearly all world-renowned tea passes through this corridor.
copy_7d5255e536fc5709: Instead of shipping raw tea hundreds of miles across the subcontinent to coastal ports for third-party packaging, our operations are stationed right here at the
copy_2a186d9f1ce0e995: When a partner garden completes its artisanal rolling, oxidation, and firing, the lot arrives at our tasting room within hours. Here, volatile monoterpenes—the aromatic compounds responsible for high-altitude muscatel, honey, and floral notes—are hermetically protected in airtight, food-grade caddies.
copy_2f95589dc06f6ad4: Airtight barrier caddies and whole orthodox leaf at our Siliguri facility.

copy_95cde9e585b9aca9: Orthodox whole-leaf tea is defined by the tender shoot at the crown of the Camellia sinensis bush. Commercial machine harvesting shears leaves indiscriminately, creating shredded stems and bitter dust.
copy_0bac086a7f636993: By contrast, our partner gardens practice gentle, manual hand-plucking of the top two young leaves and the unopened silver bud. This apical shoot holds the highest concentration of L-theanine, catechins, and essential ethereal oils, resulting in the silky mouthfeel and floral clarity characteristic of premium single-estate tea.

copy_67b6b9dd614d97d7: In West Bengal, tea is not merely a morning beverage—it is a cultural fabric. It is the spark for unhurried intellectual adda, the warm welcome to an honored guest, and a quiet moment of solitary peace as the afternoon sun casts long shadows over the verandah.
copy_1668e64467b50d97: We celebrate all expressions of this tradition: from brisk CTC brewed with creamy milk and warming crushed ginger, to fragrant Gondhoraj lebu cha in a clear glass, and connoisseur first flush Darjeeling poured gently from a fine porcelain gaiwan.
